# Messages Ops

Curated by Skill Harbor: an evidence-first workflow for live message retrieval across iMessage, social DMs, and other browser-gated message surfaces. Use it when you want to read texts, recover a recent one-time code, inspect a thread before replying, or prove which message source was actually checked. The workflow resolves the exact thread first (surface, sender, time window, retrieval vs inspection vs reply prep), reads the latest inbound before drafting any follow-up, and treats one-time codes as a focused retrieval task. Guardrails are explicit: name the source you checked, never claim a thread was checked without naming it, never improvise raw database access when a checked helper exists, and report the exact blocker when auth or MFA stands in the way. Hands off to email-ops, connections-optimizer, lead-intelligence, or knowledge-ops when the task belongs to those surfaces. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: local-device centric; reading messages is privacy-sensitive, use it only on your own messages; auth or MFA can block a surface, and the skill reports the blocker instead of working around it. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
